description: Capabilities for the main window and the persistent capture frame. Capabilities are scoped by window label, so a window missing from this list gets none at all. `core:window:default` is read-only — it grants inner_size, outer_position and scale_factor but not set-size or set-position — and only start-dragging is added on top, so the main window's title bar and the frame's grip can hand a drag to the OS. Moving and resizing go through commands rather than opening window geometry to the frontend, and the title bar's own minimise, maximise and close are commands for the same reason: `minimize_window`, `toggle_maximize`, `close_window`. Drawing our own caption therefore needs no new permission here.
